touchdownZone.definition: RWY 35 precision-approach touchdown zone, threshold to 900 m

physicalSouthEnd.derivation: 600 m reciprocal extension from RWY 35 threshold; 3283 m physical runway length minus 2683 m RWY 35 LDA

glidepath.corridorNote: Vertical bounds use the standard 1.4 degree ILS glide-path beam width; lateral visual width equals RWY 17/35 width and is not a localizer tolerance.
